caption: The drawing features a large, brown ceramic jug with a narrow neck and no handle, occupying the center of the composition. The jug has a rounded body that tapers to a pointed base, and its surface is variegated with shades of brown and gray, creating a textured appearance. Near the top of the jug, an embossed design is visible, showing an eagle perched on a cannon with the word "CHARLESTOWN" below it. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller representation of a similar jug, which also has a brown body but includes a handle attached near the neck. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white. In the lower right region, the artist's name "N. Amantea" is written.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
